simp.text: 有人牵来了一头好大好大的大象！

trad.text: 有人牽來了一頭好大好大的大象！
trad.bpmf: 有人牽來了一󠇢頭好大好大的大象！

example.en: Someone had led in an enormous elephant!

simp.text: 那五个朋友一听，都开心地伸出手。

trad.text: 那五個朋友一聽，都開心地伸出手。
trad.bpmf: 那五個󠇡朋友一󠇢聽，都開心地󠇡伸出手。

example.en: The five friends heard this and happily reached out their hands.

simp.text: 第一个人摸到了大象的腿。

trad.text: 第一個人摸到了大象的腿。
trad.bpmf: 第一個󠇡人摸到了大象的腿。

example.en: The first person touched the elephant's leg.

simp.text: 第二个人摸到了大象的尾巴。

trad.text: 第二個人摸到了大象的尾巴。
trad.bpmf: 第二個󠇡人摸到了大象的尾巴。

example.en: The second person touched the elephant's tail.

simp.text: 第三个人摸到的是大象的鼻子。

trad.text: 第三個人摸到的是大象的鼻子。
trad.bpmf: 第三個󠇡人摸到的是大象的鼻子󠇡。

example.en: The third person touched the elephant's trunk.

simp.text: 两只手刚好摸到一片大耳朵。

trad.text: 兩隻手剛好摸到一片大耳朵。
trad.bpmf: 兩隻手剛好摸到一󠇡片大耳朵󠇡。

example.en: His two hands happened to land on a big flat ear.

simp.text: 他伸手摸到大象的身体。

trad.text: 他伸手摸到大象的身體。
trad.bpmf: 他伸手摸到大象的身體。

example.en: He reached out and touched the elephant's body.

simp.text: 尾巴尖儿还有一小团毛。

trad.text: 尾巴尖兒還有一小團毛。
trad.bpmf: 尾巴尖兒還有一󠇢小團毛。

example.en: At the tip of the tail there was even a little tuft of hair.

simp.text: 明明就像一条弯弯的大蛇。

trad.text: 明明就像一條彎彎的大蛇。
trad.bpmf: 明明就像一󠇢條彎彎的大蛇。

example.en: It is clearly like a big curving snake.
An elephant is clearly like a wall.

simp.text: 大象就像房子里的大柱子。

trad.text: 大象就像房子裡的大柱子。
trad.bpmf: 大象就像房子󠇡裡的大柱子󠇡。

example.en: An elephant is just like the big pillar in a house.
It is clearly like a rope.

simp.text: 这明明就像一把大扇子。

trad.text: 這明明就像一把大扇子。
trad.bpmf: 這明明就像一󠇢把大扇子󠇡。

example.en: This is clearly like a big fan.

simp.text: 全都放下手上正在剥的花生。

trad.text: 全都放下手上正在剝的花生。
trad.bpmf: 全都放下手上正在剝的花生。

example.en: They all put down the peanuts they were shelling.

vocab.en: the village gate, the entrance to the village

example.en: Step by step they walked toward the village gate.

vocab.en: blind men feeling an elephant: to judge the whole from one small piece you happen to know, and be sure you are right

simp.text: 这个故事叫做「盲人摸象」。

trad.text: 這個故事叫做「盲人摸象」。
trad.bpmf: 這個󠇡故事叫做「盲人摸象」。

example.en: This story is called "blind men feeling an elephant".
They were very curious.
The more they thought about it, the more excited they got.
He could not help shouting out.
He stepped forward and said politely.

simp.text: 其实，你们每个人讲的都没有错。

trad.text: 其實，你們每個人講的都沒有錯。
trad.bpmf: 其實，你們每個󠇡人講的都沒有錯。

example.en: Actually, every one of you is right.

simp.text: 就以为那是整头大象了。

trad.text: 就以為那是整頭大象了。
trad.bpmf: 就以為那是整頭大象了。

example.en: And so they assumed that was the whole elephant.

simp.text: 他上下摸了好几遍，很有把握地大喊。

trad.text: 他上下摸了好幾遍，很有把握地大喊。
trad.bpmf: 他上下摸了好幾遍，很有把握地󠇡大喊。

example.en: He felt all over it a few times, then shouted with great confidence.

vocab.en: to insist, to hold firmly to

example.en: The one who said pillar insisted it was a pillar.

vocab.en: to persuade, to talk someone round

example.en: But no one could persuade anyone else.

vocab.en: to imagine, to picture in the mind

simp.text: 一样一样在心里合起来想像。

trad.text: 一樣一樣在心裡合起來想像。
trad.bpmf: 一󠇡樣一󠇡樣在心裡合起來想像。

example.en: One by one they put the pieces together in their minds and imagined it.

simp.text: 每个人都只知道一小部分。

trad.text: 每個人都只知道一小部分。
trad.bpmf: 每個󠇡人都只知道一󠇢小部分󠇡。

example.en: Each person knew only one small part.

simp.text: 才能真正了解事情完整的样子。

trad.text: 才能真正了解事情完整的樣子。
trad.bpmf: 才能真正了󠇡解事情完整的樣子󠇡。

example.en: Only then can you truly understand the whole picture.
Very carefully, they reached forward to touch it.

vocab.en: unable to wait a moment longer

simp.text: 迫不及待想亲手去摸摸看。

trad.text: 迫不及待想親手去摸摸看。
trad.bpmf: 迫不及待想親手去摸摸看。

example.en: They could not wait to feel it with their own hands.
